column1: # clues.tsv for ft_show_tab — hints only, never answers.
# (The function prints the whole table itself: many lines per call, so this single
#  member-less hint fires on any failure.)

For each element, which fields does the subject have ft_show_tab display, and in which order? What marks the end of the array: a str that is a NULL pointer, or one that is an empty string? Does an element whose string is empty stop your loop early? The size is an int: how do you turn it into characters that write() can take?
